decisions.decision: Heartbeat watchdog only activates after first real OSC packet received
decisions.rationale: Serial commands were being killed after 500ms by the watchdog since no OSC packets existed. Added hasReceivedOsc_ flag to gate the watchdog, making serial debugging usable long-term.

decisions.decision: Pan acceleration confirmed tunable and visible at 2000 steps/s^2
decisions.rationale: User wanted to see deceleration with own eyes. Temporarily lowered from 20000 to 2000, confirmed visible ~2s ramp. Reverted to original — user will tune later with camera mounted.

decisions.decision: Companion v4.2.6 button repeat uses Internal: While Loop
decisions.rationale: No simple repeat interval field in v4.x. Must use While Loop + local variable is_held + Internal: Wait 100ms pattern.
